about.title: Inglewood Product Liability Claims
about.longDescription: A product that fails in Inglewood does not have to fail dramatically to change someone's life. A space heater in a Manchester Boulevard apartment, a child seat buckled in for a drive down Prairie Avenue, a pressure cooker in a kitchen off Century Boulevard — when any of these breaks down because of how it was designed, built, or labeled, California law places responsibility on the companies that put it into your hands. That is strict liability in practice: you generally do not need to prove the maker was careless, only that the product was defective and that the defect caused your injury. Inglewood sits in Los Angeles County, where a single purchase can pass through several businesses before it reaches you. Each link in that chain — manufacturer, distributor, retailer — may share responsibility. LawProactive is not a law firm. We are a free service that connects Inglewood residents with an independent attorney who takes product cases on contingency, so there is no fee unless there is a recovery.

whyChoose.title: Why Inglewood Residents Turn to LawProactive

items.title: Strict liability works in your favor
items.desc: In California you usually do not have to prove the manufacturer was negligent — showing the product was defective and caused your injury is generally enough. The attorney we connect you with knows how to frame a design, manufacturing, or warning defect under that standard.

items.title: Every company in the chain is on the table
items.desc: Manufacturers, distributors, and the Inglewood retailer who sold the item may all be liable. An independent attorney can identify each responsible party rather than stopping at the first name on the box.

items.title: Preserving the evidence starts now
items.desc: The product itself is the heart of the case, so it should be kept, not repaired or thrown away. Getting connected quickly helps make sure that evidence is protected before it disappears.

items.question: My airbag didn't deploy in a crash on Century Boulevard. Is that a car accident case or a product case?
items.answer: It can be both. Inglewood recorded 446 injury collisions in 2025, and some of those involve vehicles or parts that did not perform as designed. If a restraint, airbag, or brake component failed, the carmaker or part manufacturer may be liable under strict liability in addition to any other driver. An attorney can look at both angles once the vehicle is preserved.

items.question: I threw away the broken product. Can I still bring a claim?
items.answer: It is harder, but not always impossible. Photos, receipts, packaging, medical records, and the same model purchased separately can still help establish the defect. If you still have the item, stop using it and store it exactly as it is — do not attempt repairs.

items.question: What does it cost to use LawProactive?
items.answer: Nothing. LawProactive is a free connection service, not a law firm, and there is no charge for being matched with an independent attorney. The attorneys in our network work on contingency, which means no fee unless there is a recovery in your case.
